issue.title: github.rs: a typed REST + GraphQL client for Epik's verbs
issue.body:
Sub-issue of #102. Design: `docs/design-history/2026-08-05-coding-agents-and-tools.md`.

A hand-rolled client in `crates/epik` beside `chat.rs`, on the `OpenAiCompatible` precedent: synchronous, no SDK crate (`octocrab` rejected — async/tokio against a synchronous library, and it misses the GraphQL mutations anyway). REST for issues (get/create/edit/comment/close), PRs (open/get/merge), check conclusions, default branch; GraphQL (POST `/graphql`) for sub-issue add/remove and blocked-by set/remove. The surface covers exactly Epik's verbs, nothing more. Typed errors, with rate limiting distinguished from failure. Stringliness confined to the module.

Testing, shaped by secretless CI: a unit tier against captured payloads; an unauthenticated read smoke against this public repo in CI; mutation tests run locally against a scratch repo only when a token is present, and are required nowhere — no secret enters CI.

Acceptance: the parent feature's acceptance list is achievable through this module alone.
